audioFiles.text: at dusk, in Decayed Sector - Outer Rim, Cautious hope amidst overwhelming decay.

audioFiles.direction: Whispering to themselves, eyes scanning the desolation, a hand hovering over a faint energy signature.
audioFiles.text: Another echo. Faint. Barely a whisper against the void.

audioFiles.direction: A sigh escapes them, but their gaze remains fixed, a flicker of stubbornness in their eyes.
audioFiles.text: The Archive. A myth, they said. Just… dust.

audioFiles.direction: A tremor in their voice, as if asking the universe for an answer it won't give.
audioFiles.text: But even dust remembers. Doesn’t it?
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Outer Chambers, Growing apprehension and the weight of forgotten truths.

audioFiles.direction: Their fingers fly across a holographic interface, eyes wide with disbelief and growing dread.
audioFiles.text: No… this isn't decay. This is… erasure.

audioFiles.direction: A cold sweat breaks out on their brow. They lean heavily against a console, the weight of the data crushing them.
audioFiles.text: Billions of years. Entire civilizations. Gone. Not forgotten, but… un-made.

audioFiles.direction: A data fragment flickers, revealing a shielded energy signature. Their hand instinctively goes to their weapon.
audioFiles.text: And a guardian. Protecting… what? The nothingness?
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Data Antechamber, Urgent dread and hardened resolve.

audioFiles.direction: They clench their jaw, the initial shock giving way to a grim, steely determination.
audioFiles.text: This isn't just about saving memories. It's about saving… everything.

audioFiles.direction: Their voice is low, firm. They activate their suit's comms, though there's no one to hear.
audioFiles.text: That guardian. It stands between us and… truth.

audioFiles.direction: They push off the console, moving with renewed, albeit desperate, purpose towards the deeper chambers.
audioFiles.text: I won't let another truth fade.
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Collapsing Corridors, Desperate struggle against overwhelming odds.

audioFiles.direction: They narrowly dodge a crumbling section of the corridor, a shower of debris raining down.
audioFiles.text: Void energy… it's actively tearing it apart.

audioFiles.direction: Their breath hitches as the structural decay visibly accelerates around them.
audioFiles.text: Faster. It's moving faster.

audioFiles.direction: A shudder runs through them as they feel the cold, consuming presence of the Oblivion Weaver nearby.
audioFiles.text: This isn't just a force. It's… hungry.
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Central Absorption Chamber, Crushing sense of futility and sacrifice.

audioFiles.direction: They watch in horror as a console flickers, then turns to dust, the information irretrievable.
audioFiles.text: It’s not just destroying structures… it's consuming the data itself.

audioFiles.direction: Their shoulders slump. The sheer scale of what's being lost is overwhelming, almost paralyzing.
audioFiles.text: Every shard of knowledge… gone. Forever.

audioFiles.direction: A single tear traces a path through the grime on their cheek, but their gaze hardens.
audioFiles.text: This isn't just a fight. It's an elegy.
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Central Absorption Chamber, Desperate, escalating struggle.

audioFiles.direction: They lunge, but a wave of void energy slams into them, throwing them backward, the console they aimed for dissolving.
audioFiles.text: No! Not that data!

audioFiles.direction: Coughing, they struggle to their feet, clutching a bruised rib. The Weaver's hum deepens, mocking.
audioFiles.text: It's too strong. Too… pervasive.

audioFiles.direction: A new, grim strategy forms in their mind. They look at the Weaver, then at the data-core, a terrible choice dawning.
audioFiles.text: Then I won't fight it directly. I'll… starve it.
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Data-Core Nexus, Catastrophic urgency and impending doom.

audioFiles.direction: They activate a complex sequence, energy arcing from their gauntlet towards the Weaver's core.
audioFiles.text: Now! Disrupt the field!

audioFiles.direction: The Archive groans, a sound of dying stone and metal. Warning alarms blare, flashing red.
audioFiles.text: It's… collapsing! The whole sector!

audioFiles.direction: They are trapped. The path behind them has vanished into the void, the path ahead crumbling rapidly.
audioFiles.text: No escape. Not now.
under the cover of darkness, in Sundered Archive - Collapsing Data-Core Nexus, Futility, sacrifice, and a desperate grasp for survival.

audioFiles.direction: Ignoring the collapsing environment, they scramble towards the data-core, which is also fragmenting.
audioFiles.text: The core! I have to… secure it!

audioFiles.direction: A scream is stifled as a piece of falling debris pins their arm, tearing through their suit, void energy beginning to consume it.
audioFiles.text: My arm… it's fusing…

audioFiles.direction: With a guttural roar, they force their free hand to pull the data-core free, even as their pinned arm begins to crystalize.
audioFiles.text: Worth it. For the memory.
at dawn, in Void Edge - Archive Remains, A costly, Pyrrhic 'victory' and exhaustion.

audioFiles.direction: They collapse onto the cosmic debris field, gasping for air, clutching the fragmented data-core to their chest.
audioFiles.text: Out… I'm out.

audioFiles.direction: They look back at the swirling void where the Archive once stood, a hollow ache in their chest, their arm throbbing.
audioFiles.text: The Archive… gone. All of it.

audioFiles.direction: They hold up the data-core, a faint, flickering light against the cosmic black, a testament to their costly survival.
audioFiles.text: But I have this. This sliver.
at dawn, in Desolate Vantage Point - Cosmic Debris Field, Terrified realization and dawning horror.

audioFiles.direction: Their eyes dart across the deciphered data, a cold dread washing over them, worse than any collapse.
audioFiles.text: No. This can't be right.

audioFiles.direction: Their voice is a whisper, barely audible over the hum of their console. The truth is far more sinister.
audioFiles.text: The entropy… it's not natural. It's… guided.

audioFiles.direction: They recoil from the screen, the implications of the data sending shivers down their spine. The void is not indifferent; it is an instrument.
audioFiles.text: Someone is doing this. Someone… or something.
at dawn, in Desolate Vantage Point - Cosmic Debris Field, Hardened, terrified resolve in the face of a greater, personal threat.

audioFiles.direction: They stare into the vastness of space, the fragmented data-core clutched tight. They are no longer merely fighting decay.
audioFiles.text: A shepherd of oblivion. And I've just announced my presence.

audioFiles.direction: Their gaze is fixed, unwavering, despite the fear. The threat is no longer cosmic, but personal and direct.
audioFiles.text: They know I'm here. They know I have this.

audioFiles.direction: A painful, determined set to their jaw. The fear of loss is still there, but now it fuels a grim, unyielding purpose.
audioFiles.text: Let them come. I won't let another memory die.
